Notification NO.NPSC/ADVT-1/04(VOL-1) dt. 28.10.2026 (CTSE 2026 Re-examination Mechanical Engg. (Diploma) Paper I & II) 
 Published on : 28-10-2026 06:14 pm 
 NAGALAND PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION 
 KOHIMA 
NO.NPSC/ADVT-1/04(VOL-1) Dated,
Kohima the 28 th October, 2026 
 NOTIFICATION 
In pursuance of
the Commission’s decision, this is to notify that the examination held on 6 th and 7 th October 2026 in Mechanical
Engineering (Diploma) descriptive Paper
I & II (CTSE -2026) stand cancelled. The date for re-examination is
scheduled to 21 st November,
2026. Those candidates who have not appeared
GE & GK Paper on 26 th September, 2026 shall not be allowed to sit
for re-examination. No fresh admission certificate shall be issued. Examination
timing will be from 09:00 am to 12:00 noon & 01:00 pm to 04:00 pm
respectively. 
Sd/ (NUNGSANGMENLA IMCHEN) 
Secretary 
Nagaland Public Service Commission
